unresolved.first_comment: P2: httpx2 is added to the required dependencies, but the dual-import code relies on httpx2 being optional (except ModuleNotFoundError: import httpx). Because httpx2 is now always installed, that fallback is dead code, and every reflex install is forced to pull httpx2

P3: This try/except dual-import block is duplicated verbatim in 7+ files (net.py has 4 copies). It is not a circular-import case, so it belongs in a shared helper, e.g. def _import_httpx() in reflex/utils/net.py

failing_job_findings.cause: pyright fails on reflex/utils/net.py (5 errors): the dual-import yields union types httpx2.HTTPTransport | httpx.HTTPTransport and httpx2.Proxy | httpx.Proxy that are not assignable to the single-library Client(transport=, mounts=, proxy=) parameters, and the wrapped get/post/head union is not assignable to _wrap_https_lazy_func; check_min_deps reports the same net.py:175/188 errors at the declared minimum versions.
towncrier check finds no news fragment for the reflex package although the PR touches reflex/**; needs news/<pr>.<type>.md or the skip-changelog label.
